title: First real evaluation: autonomy correctly withheld
body: On 500 archived CFPB complaints, Jev reached 74.8% product accuracy against 55% for keyword rules, at about 5 cents per 1,000 complaints. It was overconfident, though: cases stated as 99% certain were right 83% of the time. Recalibration halved the calibration error, but no threshold reached 95% precision at the lower bound, so every case still goes to a person. Next: route on operational groups and narrow the regulatory-risk question.

title: Evaluation moved to a fixed archive sample
body: The CFPB stopped publishing complaint narratives in its live database on 14 August 2026. ConductOS now evaluates every model version on the same seeded sample of 1,000 archived complaints, so changes in the numbers reflect the model, not the data.

title: ConductOS walking skeleton
body: Real CFPB complaints go through Jev triage, a keyword baseline, a deterministic supervisor and a calibration harness. Every case routes to human review until the harness publishes a safe threshold.

title: Product strategy, PRDs and red-team review
body: Strategy canvas, opportunity solution tree, four PRDs, autonomy and guardrail policy, metrics spec, outcome roadmap and a red-team review of the plan's riskiest assumptions.
